headline: Quiet follow-up to the 8 PM run. Grumpy Walrus sold 1M CRAWJU (~432 ADA) and 5M Guinea Pig (~324 ADA) at 8:27 PM, sent ~400 ADA to an outside wallet, swapped 103 ASCEND (~109 ADA, ~325.0k left), 250k MEPE and 250k Quantum SNEK into NIGHT (~1.9k NIGHT added), added ~0.92M CITY (~142 ADA), opened a tiny IAG position (~179 IAG) and received 100k COCK from an outside wallet. Net ADA ~-30 since 8:08 PM. HERO top cluster rose to ~30.7% of supply, still under the 50% red line. TECHMAGE hit launch+24h with no DEX pool, so it stays in the SW-01 comparison group. Nothing passes k/y; no SW-01 ticket.
learned: Lessons: after a heavy selling stretch, Grumpy Walrus went back to small cleanup sales and dust-size swaps within an hour, so one big exit burst is not a sign that more of the same is coming right away.
